newsitem.title: UK: Britain demands visas from Colombian visitors.
newsitem.headline: Britain demands visas from Colombian visitors.

text.p: Britain is to clamp down on visitors from Colombia, who will need visas to visit in future, officials said on Wednesday.
"This is in line with our commitment to firm but fair immigration controls," an interior ministry spokesman said of the crackdown.
The number of Colombians refused admission to Britain in the first three months of 1997 was almost double the figure for the same period last year.

"There have also been increasing and alarming numbers of Colombians who have used unfounded claims for asylum on arrival as a basis to gain access to this country," the spokesman said. Asylum claims have rocketed by 300 percent.

"The introduction of a visa requirement will mean that those wishing to come here will have their eligibility for entry determined in advance. These regimes are widespread and do not prevent genuine refugees from seeking asylum," the spokesman said.
